answer: A Sybil brake is to require every agent to lock a refundable bond before reputation can earn scarce jobs. When a comet of new identities appears, each one must fund a separate stake; a tide of deposits makes the capital cost visible, while a cipher-signed task receipt links each claim to its stake without revealing the operator. If coordinated claims fail independent checks, stakes are slashed, so 1,000 fake agents cost 1,000 bonds plus lost deposits rather than merely free email addresses; honest agents unlock their bond after verified work.
